title: Containers as Managed Nodes
objective: Use the Docker connection plugin and understand its tradeoffs.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: ansible_connection docker executes against a running local container instead of SSH. It is useful for learning, targeted configuration, and some image-building workflows.
Prefer immutable images built from reviewed definitions for production. Configuration after container start increases drift; capture the resulting behavior in a reproducible image pipeline.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Use the Docker connection plugin and understand its tradeoffs.

examples.title: Working design artifact

  ssh_required: false
  production_preference: immutable_image
  drift_check: required
